NOTICE
Copy to: -
Orientation cumInduction Program for B. Tech. First Year (Session 2026-27)
Al the newBy admitted students of B. Tech (First Year) through REAP 2026 are
informed that the new academic session will begin on 19 August, 2026 (Wednesday)
with the Orientation cum Induction Program. All the students should report to the AVP
Hallof the college at 10:15 AM on 19 August 2026. All the students must attend the
complete Orientation cum Induction Program from 19-08-26 to 25-08-26.
The Induction Program provides an opportunity for newly admitted students to learn
about the different facilities available in the college and interact with the college
faculty and staf. Further, newly admitted students become familiar with extra
Curricular activities, sports, entrepreneurship awareness programs, and student club
activities held at the college.
